feeds.title: The Fabric Store Blog
feeds.description: Find endless sewing inspiration on our blog with sew-alongs, pattern reviews, DIY and scrap-busting project ideas, and more! The Fabric Store is the destination for the handmade sewing and creative community in Australasia. With 8 stores across New Zealand and Australia, we offer a curated range of responsibly sourced designer and exclusive fabrics, specializing in natural fibers such as linen, merino, cotton, and silk.

feeds.title: Miss Maude Blog
feeds.description: Miss Maude is a boutique fabric, yarn, and haberdashery store that has a curated selection of quality, natural fiber dressmaking fabrics; independent sewing patterns; knitting yarns; and haberdashery to delight, inspire and bring joy. Our products are selected for their beauty, quality, and ability to delight and inspire.

feeds.title: Sewing Time Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with the latest household and industrial sewing blogs and news, along with tips for your next project from Sewingtime, NZ. Sewingtime is New Zealand's sewing equipment specialist. We supply the highest quality products from the world's leading brands to enhance your sewing experience, whether you are a beginner or looking to start your own business.

feeds.title: The Dreamstress
feeds.description: I'm Leimomi Oakes, a costumier fashion and textile historian, former museum professional, potential Ph.D. student, sewing teacher, writer, and more. The Dreamstress website is a window into my world: my projects, new things I learn, things I know so well I can teach, the amazing places I live and the amazing places I visit, the wonderful people I am surrounded by, anything interesting that catches my fancy that I think might catch yours, and, of course, Felicity the cat.

feeds.title: Little Kiwis Closet Blog
feeds.description: My name is Lydia, the designer behind Little Kiwis Closet. I live in New Zealand with my husband and my 3 children; Brylie, Elijah, and Portia who are the inspiration behind every single one of my patterns. So I decided to make her another pair myself, this started me on the journey of learning how to draft and grade patterns which have been exciting and challenging.

feeds.title: Below The Kowhai Blog
feeds.description: This is my little family. We live under a giant tree in Christchurch, New Zealand. Together, we make up the Below the Kowhai team! It is my dream to teach other people how to sew, so they too could experience this wonderful escapism and opportunity to create! Our range has expanded as our patterns and their reputation have made them a staple in handmade wardrobes around the world.

feeds.title: The Sewing Depot Blog
feeds.description: We are a boutique sewing shop based in Petone, Wellington, and are here to supply you with all the tools and supplies you need for sewing. Both in-store and online you will find a large range of home sewing machines, machine accessories, sewing tools, threads, scissors, pattern-making supplies, haberdashery, embroidery essentials, and all the necessities for knitting and crocheting.

feeds.title: Bernina Northland Blog
feeds.description: Keep updated for sewing inspiration, tips, and patterns to help you improve your everyday sewing. Bernina Northland is the Sewing Experts, wherever you are in New Zealand. Proudly owned and operated by Sandy and Tim Robinson.

feeds.title: The Eye of a Needle Blog
feeds.description: Read my blog about my various passions and find out more about my sewing and garden projects, business, makeovers, travel, and just some inspiration for my readers. The Eye Of A Needle is a one-stop sewing shop - for all your sewing supplies. We stock patchwork fabric, linen fabric, sewing accessories, kits, and a small range of giftware in our Taupo stores.

feeds.title: Studio Of Sewing Blog
feeds.description: I'm Karina, Owner & Founder of the Studio of Sewing. I truly love sewing and everything related to sewing. I think I have a thread for veins.

feeds.title: Plum Kitchen
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Kristina from Auckland, New Zealand. In no particular order, I love sewing, mysteries, cake, cats, Agatha Christie, crafting, cooking, and Chardonnay. Ad this blog is about everything I love.

feeds.title: Kat Makes Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Kat, and my blog is a little bit of everything, a DIY blog, a portfolio, a tutorial list, and a wedding dress progress snapshot! Pour yourself a nice cup of whatever it is you drink, and stick around for a while!
